# Basis of the rules

|  |
| --- |
| [The Law of the People's Republic of China on Advertising (amended in 2021)] (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2023/art_5474cf75173c45d6a0379730fb4e8d97.html): Reference is made to articles 9, 11(14), 16(28), 37(44), 46. |
| [The Administration of Internet Advertising (in effect from 1 May 2023)] (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2023/art_d93a579afd45413e8576e4623fab348f.html): Reference is made to Article 6 §18. |
| [The Law of the People's Republic of China on Anti-Improper Competition (as amended in 2025, in force since 15 October 2025)] (https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181971552b40197b1016efc5437&title=%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD%E5%8F%8D%E4%B8%8D%E6%AD%A3%E5%BD%93%E7%AB%9E%E4%BA%89%E6%B3%95): Focus on false or misleading commercial propaganda under article 9 and commercial defamation under article 12. |
| [Publication of requirements for eco-governance of web content] (https://www.cac.gov.cn/2019-12/20/c_1578375159431916.htm): Reference to illegal information, bad information and web-based eco-governance requirements. |
| [Law Enforcement Guide on the Application of the Law of the People ' s Republic of China on Advertising (I)] (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/ggjgs/art/2026/art_75bdff5f79d047d287f795c205c78d3b.html): used to determine whether information has marketing, media, audience-specific and non-mandatory advertising features. |
